name: part1
hook: Better engines made Britain burn MORE coal
post: 1865: steam engines got far more efficient, so Britain should have burned less coal. It burned more. Then light got 3,000x cheaper, and we used 40,000x more. Part 1 of 3. #ai #economics #jevonsparadox #energy #tech #history #google #bigmac #thecurve

name: part2
post: A million tokens: about $60 in 2021, about 6 cents by 2024. Google now handles 3.2 quadrillion tokens a month, 300x two years earlier. Part 2 of 3. #ai #economics #jevonsparadox #energy #tech #history #google #bigmac #thecurve

name: part3
hook: What if thinking got as cheap as light?
post: Efficiency doesn't shrink demand. It unlocks it. That's why cheaper AI means more data centres, more power and more chips. Part 3 of 3. #ai #economics #jevonsparadox #energy #tech #history #google #bigmac #thecurve

name: light
hook: Light got 3,000x cheaper. We used 40,000x more.
post: Britain, 1800 to 2000: the real price of light fell about 3,000-fold, and total use rose about 40,000-fold (Fouquet & Pearson). Streetlights, shop windows, screens. #ai #economics #jevonsparadox #energy #tech #history #google #bigmac #thecurve

name: bigmacs
hook: A million AI tokens: from 10 Big Macs to 1/100 of one
post: A million tokens, about eight novels of text: around $60 in 2021, about six cents by 2024 (a16z). At $6.22 a Big Mac, from about ten to about a hundredth of one. #ai #economics #jevonsparadox #energy #tech #history #google #bigmac #thecurve

name: google
hook: Google handles 3.2 quadrillion AI tokens a month
post: Google I/O, May 2026: about 3,200 trillion tokens a month, more than 300 times the 9.7 trillion of two years earlier. #ai #economics #jevonsparadox #energy #tech #history #google #bigmac #thecurve

name: nadella
post: When a cheap Chinese model shook the markets in January 2025, Satya Nadella posted: Jevons paradox strikes again. Cheaper AI means more data centres, not fewer. #ai #economics #jevonsparadox #energy #tech #history #google #bigmac #thecurve
